annotations.title: Look up public water systems for an area

description: Public water systems for a US location, from EPA's quarterly drinking-water data (SDWA; GroundTruth checks for a new quarter monthly), with health-based violation summaries, counts of missed or late required tests (monitoring and reporting violations), and each system's latest lead 90th percentile. Input is a street address or lat/lon coordinates (the US Census geocoder gives the county and place, and the point is checked against EPA's Community Water System Service Area Boundaries; a point outside every boundary returns no systems and a message that the home may use a private well or the map may miss its system), or a two-letter state with an optional county and/or city. Each system carries match_basis: service_area_boundary, zip, city, county or state. Some of EPA's boundaries come from states and water systems and the rest are modeled by EPA, so matching is approximate; the user's water bill names their actual utility. Systems are listed by population served, and the order does not say which system serves a given home.

address.description: US street address incl. city/state (alternative to state or lat/lon)

county.description: County name (optional), e.g. Kings, Prince George's County, Richmond city

lon.description: Longitude (US; negative except Guam, NMI and the western Aleutians)

state.description: Two-letter state code, e.g. MD (with county and/or city; not sent with address or lat/lon)

name: drinking_water
title: Look up public water systems for an area
